_comment: The external seat table, read by scripts/seat.sh (through tools/launch_check.py seat) and by the usage and capacity tools. Seat: adapter (a script under .claude/scripts, one per CLI), writes (yes: the seat may edit files in its own linked worktree; no: it returns its answer on stdout and seat.sh writes <out.md>), max_concurrent (jobs of this seat that may run at once on this machine), configDir (the login's config dir, ~ expands; empty for none). Model: the id the seat runs and its list price per 1M tokens, which prices the record only (the seat spends a plan's quota). Add a seat: one row here and one adapter; add a seat's model: one row under models. The native block is the Workflow route's vocabulary: the model aliases the session's own plan serves (`ids`, the Workflow `model` values) and the effort values they accept (`efforts`); the Workflow entry injects it as args.__transport. A seat whose configDir is absent on this machine is not a seat here: every reader goes through tools/launch_check.py seat_rows, and seat.sh refuses it in one line. Native Claude models carry no row, so their lines in tools/usage_report.py are unpriced by design (the session spends a plan's quota).
